name: simcoe-walker-standing
js: (async()=>{const a=window.__CITY_APP,C=window.CITY,d=C.WATERFRONT_WAVEDECKS.find(d=>d.id==='simcoe'),x=-526,z=586,h=C.waterfrontDeckSurfaceHeight(d,x,z);if(!C.waterfrontPublicRealmEnabled)throw Error('wavedecks disabled');a.selectMode('person');a.controllerManager.teleportActiveTo(x,z,1.57,h);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1000));const p=a.controllerManager.getActiveEntity().position;if(Math.hypot(p.x-x,p.z-z)>1||Math.abs(p.y-h)>.12)throw Error('walker not standing on rendered deck '+JSON.stringify({x,z,h,p}));console.log('[waterfront-walk] '+JSON.stringify({x:p.x,y:p.y,z:p.z,expected:h}));const c={pos:[x+5,h+3,z+6],look:[x,h+1,z],fov:55};a.cameraSystem.cinema=()=>c;})()
